description: Construction of 5 residential buildings (3-5 storeys in height) to provide a range of houses and flats (total of 189 residential units); conversion of existing farmhouse and barns to provide a cafe / commercial unit (Class E); and Improved Public Access between Northala Fields & Marnham Fields with associated enhanced landscaping (Masterplan for wider Green Belt and Public Open Space), parking and refuse storage.
subdivision_of_building:
All existing buildings to be demolished with the exception of 'Locally Listed Building' & 'Outbuilding'.

Demolition of Eastern extension and erection of replacement single storey extension.
decision_conditions: The proposed development would constitute inappropriate development in the Green Belt that would harm the openness of the Green Belt and no very special circumstances have been demonstrated that are sufficient to override the conflict with Policy G2 of the London Plan (2021), Policy 5.1 of the Ealing Core Strategy (2012) and Section 13 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021). | The development by reason of its design, siting, density and scale would represent overdevelopment of the site that would contrary to policies 3.5, 7A and 7B of the Ealing Development Management DPD (2013), policies D2 and D3 of the London Plan (2021), and Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2021). | The application is not accompanied by a Circular Economy Statement and a Whole Life Carbon Statement contrary to Policies SI2 and SI7 of the London Plan (2021). | The proposed development does not demonstrate that it will incorporate adequate urban greening measures, net biodiversity gain or adequate tree replacement contrary to Policies G5, G6 and G7 of the London Plan (2021). | The submitted drainage strategy does not accord with Policies SI 5, SI12, SI13 and SI15 of the London Plan (2021). | The fire safety proposals for the proposed development lack details relating to the buildings' construction, means of escape and evacuation strategy, and ongoing maintenance and monitoring of fire access for fire service personnel and equipment. As such, they do not comply with Policy D12 of the London Plan (2021).
